description: Cancer-focused physical therapy at Utah Cancer Specialists Sandy Clinic. Personalized rehabilitation, exercise, and support during treatment and recovery.

editorContent.label: Text
editorContent.value: Support for movement, strength, and everyday life.

editorContent.label: Paragraph
editorContent.value: Cancer and its treatment can change how you feel and move. Our cancer-focused physical therapy program offers personalized support during treatment and recovery, with your everyday goals at the center of care.

editorContent.value: The services of Cancer Rehabilitation Centers (CRC) are now part of Utah Cancer Specialists. This specialized program brings physical therapy and individualized exercise together to support people affected by cancer. We work to develop a plan of care as part of your oncology team.

editorContent.value: Physical therapy can be part of care from diagnosis. Your therapist works with your oncology team to shape an individualized approach around your needs.

editorContent.section: Your starting point.Your goals. Your pace.
editorContent.value: Whether your goal is returning to a familiar routine or feeling more confident with daily activities, care begins with understanding what matters to you and your specific needs. Our physical therapy is centered around individuals receiving and recovering from cancer treatments.

editorContent.label: Link destination: Talk with our team at 801.456.9898.
Text
editorContent.value: Do I need to finish cancer treatment first?

editorContent.label: Paragraph
editorContent.value: No. The program supports patients during treatment as well as recovery. Talk with your care team about when physical therapy may be appropriate for you.

editorContent.label: Text
editorContent.value: What happens at my first visit?

editorContent.label: Paragraph
editorContent.value: A physical therapist assesses your current function and discusses your activity history and goals. This helps establish a care plan tailored to you.

editorContent.label: Text
editorContent.value: Will my insurance cover physical therapy?

editorContent.label: Paragraph
editorContent.value: The clinic works with a variety of insurance plans. Coverage and benefits vary, so call before your visit to confirm your plan and any requirements.

editorContent.label: Text
editorContent.value: Can I see the facility before getting started?

editorContent.label: Paragraph
editorContent.value: Yes. Call the clinic to arrange a tour and learn more about the cancer-focused rehabilitation setting.

editorContent.label: Text
editorContent.value: Is physical therapy beneficial for all cancer types?

editorContent.label: Text
editorContent.value: Yes. All cancer types can benefit from a structured exercise program. Research shows that specific exercise can reduce the risk of recurrence.

editorContent.label: Text
editorContent.value: Do you see any patients under the age of 18?

editorContent.label: Text
editorContent.value: How long is a typical session?

editorContent.label: Text
editorContent.value: Typically, each session is scheduled for one hour. Length of session will be determined by level of energy.
